svg.title: Velocity, acceleration and when a particle speeds up
svg.desc: Top: velocity v(t) = 3t squared minus 12t + 9 (crimson) and acceleration a(t) = 6t minus 12 (blue, dashed) for t from 0 to 4.3. Shaded bands mark where v and a have the same sign, so the particle speeds up: 1 < t < 2 (both negative) and t > 3 (both positive). It slows down on 0 < t < 1 and 2 < t < 3, where the signs differ. Bottom: the path of the particle with position x(t) = t cubed minus 6t squared + 9t on a number line: right from 0 to 4 for t from 0 to 1, left back to 0 for t from 1 to 3, right again to 4 for t from 3 to 4. It changes direction at t = 1 and t = 3, where v changes sign.
